audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart said Pantheon owns all seven rows, painting a lane far harder than the HARD-early/win-late reality; difficulty 8/10 itself is fine.
audit.why: 53.51% Viktor WR over 3594 games and packet levelChart (Pantheon/Skill x5/Viktor) both show the lane evens after level 1 and flips late.
audit.corrected: Chart rows moved (see point 3); ratings softened to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full phases[1..6].side all read Pantheon while packet and content say Skill for 2 through first item and Viktor at 2+ items.
audit.why: Content whys agree with the packet: E at level 2 stabilises, ult timings wash, Luden's out-ranges the spear, two items flip it.
audit.corrected: phases[1..6] side/rating moved, whys rewritten where they argued with the verdict; win[] already correct so no content chart edits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Viktor's E written as Death Ray in content (kit: Hextech Ray); breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; Aegis Assault (invulnerable-from-front channel, 22s early) was never mentioned; two Do's/Don'ts bodies were pasted trade lines.
audit.why: Kit: Pantheon W 13-9s point-and-click stun+dash (auto reset), E 22-18s frontal invulnerability channel — Viktor's W hard CC cancels it; his R 180s. Viktor R is an interruptible channel his W stun cancels.
audit.corrected: Names fixed, cooldowns written in, Aegis interactions folded into cooldowns and dosFull[1].d.

edits.before: Q-shield trades on his last-hits — the empowered auto walk-away is sneakily one of the better level-1 trades mid.
edits.after: His Comet Spear and point-and-click Shield Vault stun win level 1 outright — hug tower, Q-shield the poke, concede.

edits.after: Viktor

edits.before: Evolved late-game Viktor is a zone the enemy can't enter: W the choke, E the clump, and steer R through the retreat.
edits.after: Two items flip it hard: evolved E and R shred his flat-AD kit, and W turns his only engage line into a stun on him.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. Check it before every step-up. - W Gravity Field is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): 13s at rank 1 — point-and-click; respect the all-in any time it is up. - His Aegis Assault is 22s early: once it's spent, your burst actually lands. - Your W Gravity Field is 17s — the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: E through the wave into his chest, Q-shield the response, empowered-auto, and walk — a full trade where his answer hit a shield.
edits.after: His Shield Vault reaches 600 — fire the laser from beyond it or through minions at an angle, so poking never invites the stun.

edits.before: Casting E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — Viktor's cast times are an assassin's favorite metronome.
edits.after: Shield Vault is point-and-click — the field must be down before he dashes, because after the stun lands it is too late.

edits.before: Pantheon's Q spear and reliable W stun let him win the level-1 all-in before your Death Ray exists.
edits.after: Pantheon's Q spear and reliable W stun let him win the level-1 all-in before your Hextech Ray exists.

edits.before: This is Pantheon's window, not yours: with Q spear poke and a point-and-click W stun he can walk you down before your Death Ray upgrade is online, so respect his all-in whenever his passive Mortal Will is stacked.
edits.after: This is Pantheon's window, not yours: with Q spear poke and a point-and-click W stun he can walk you down before your Hextech Ray upgrade is online, so respect his all-in whenever his passive Mortal Will is stacked.
